BiblicalUsage: Cheylah is a rampart, a defensive wall, and it stands once in the psalm that walks around Zion. The singer is told to mark well her bulwarks and consider her palaces, so that the strength of the city can be told to the generation following.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the ramparts of Zion are worth marking because they are God's own defences, and the church still walks round them today.
